license_interpretation: The Iris-Z weights are derived from FLUX.2 [dev] and FLUX.2 [klein] Base 9B and are under Black Forest Labs' FLUX Non-Commercial License, a custom agreement that is not OSI-approved: no commercial or production use, and Section 2(e) asks for content filtering or human review of generated images before they are shared. LibreYOLO's adapter is MIT; the transformer, samplers and prompt embedders it ports from the Speridlabs Iris-Z SDK keep Apache-2.0, as does the FLUX.2 code the SDK builds on, with their notices in libreyolo/models/gen/speridlabs_irisz/NOTICE. LibreYOLO does not redistribute any weights. They download at runtime, unmodified, from their publishers at pinned revisions: speridlabs/iris-z at 16239e1a5444c484b11a04b61d633eceb768574c (9b from Iris-Z-small, 32b from Iris-Z-big, not gated), the FLUX.2 VAE from black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B (Apache-2.0), and the text encoders Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8 for 9b and mistralai/Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506 for 32b (both Apache-2.0).
